recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a male and female duo against a textured teal and green wall, featuring a bold horizontal translucent banner across the center containing clean, geometric sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the man's black leather textures and the woman's white lace/tulle fabrics.
The horizontal banner acts as a visual bridge connecting the two subjects.
Complementary relationship between the warm skin tones and the cool-toned, distressed background.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects positioned side-by-side, filling the frame from the waist up; the male on the left slightly behind the female on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal text banner positioned at the vertical center of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subjects' faces, move down to the central text banner, and then follow the textures of their clothing.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, with the subjects and background texture occupying the entire frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal and seafoam green (background and banner overlay).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and gold jewelry details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white dress and black leather; background has medium saturation with a distressed, matte finish.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Q' features a stylized tail that follows the circular curve of the bowl.
The 'R' has a straight, diagonal leg starting from the vertical stem.

composition.scale: Large, spanning nearly the full width
composition.overlap: Placed on top of a translucent banner

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact and clarity.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric proportions and sharp points.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a male in a black leather jacket and flat cap next to a female in a white lace dress. The background should be a textured, distressed teal and green wall. Leave the center horizontal third clear for an overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a semi-transparent dark teal horizontal bar across the center. Place all-caps geometric sans-serif text in white, centered on the bar with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture visible through the teal bar?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress on the background wall

mustAchieve: Rich color contrast between teal and skin tones

postGenerationChecks: Check for monolinear stroke weight in typography.
Ensure the translucent bar does not fully obscure the subjects.
Verify the teal color palette is consistent across the background and banner.
Confirm the all-caps setting for the display text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Duo portrait + textured teal wall + central translucent banner + geometric white sans-serif.
